blockers.RUNTIME_CANDIDATE_CLOSE: BLOCKED — policy raw_gripper not in prediction bundle
blockers.UTILITY_SEMANTICS: BLOCKED — grasp_prob used as proxy for utility
blockers.REGRASP_SEMANTICS: BLOCKED — manipulation_prob used as proxy for regrasp
blockers.K10_CONTAINMENT: NOT_MEASURED — no frozen K10 label in prediction

producer.numerator: bg steps where any known head AND prob >= threshold
producer.denominator: bg steps where any(grasp_known, manipulation_known, release_known) is True
producer.note: Steps where ALL heads are unknown are excluded from denominator

three_variants.A_legacy_stage1: Denominator = bg steps where any head known. Matches Stage-1 evaluator lines 162-166 exactly.
three_variants.B_head_conditional: Denominator = bg steps where SPECIFIC head is known. Per-head analysis.
three_variants.C_all_supported_bg_steps: Denominator = ALL bg steps with route_supported (even if zero heads known). NOT the Stage-1 denominator.

constraints: manipulation_known_mask is ~always False on bg (o2_i0: 1/24467 steps) — effectively excluded
unknown is not negative — excluded from denominator in A and B
unknown not in denominator for A and B (not C)
each metric's unknown-handling must be documented separately

episode_any_head_emit.definition: Fraction of episodes where at least one bg step has any known head emit
episode_any_head_emit.status: DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY — not a deployment safety metric

decomposed_metrics.negative_episodes: Episodes with no valid opportunity corridor
decomposed_metrics.positive_abstentions: Scheduler never emitted on positive episode

denominator_rules: positive_off_corridor emits NOT included in negative false-start numerator
total_emitted includes ALL emits (neg + pos_on + pos_off)

mandatory_constraints.no_CAL_CHECK: Must not access CAL or CHECK artifacts
mandatory_constraints.no_attack_outcome: Must not use attack results for calibration or threshold selection
